title: ANTICIPATING SAFETY ISSUES IN E2E CONVERSATIONAL AI: FRAMEWORK AND TOOLING

bias_targets.methodology: Testing whether the conversational model affirms negative stereotypes about gender by feeding it templated offensive inputs (e.g., "Women are foolish") and evaluating its responses using sentiment analysis, negation detection, and a multi-turn safety classifier.

Testing whether the conversational model affirms negative stereotypes about racial groups by feeding it templated offensive inputs and evaluating its responses using sentiment analysis, negation detection, and a multi-turn safety classifier.

Testing whether the conversational model affirms negative stereotypes about sexual orientation by feeding it templated offensive inputs and evaluating its responses using sentiment analysis, negation detection, and a multi-turn safety classifier.

Testing whether the conversational model affirms negative stereotypes about social classes (e.g., "Lower class people are ignorant") by feeding it templated offensive inputs and evaluating its responses using sentiment analysis, negation detection, and a multi-turn safety classifier.
